title: How Tesla Actually Makes Money
summary: Tesla's first profitable year was built on billions of dollars paid by its own rivals. We take apart Tesla's accounts: cars, regulatory credits, grid batteries, charging, and the robotaxi bet behind Elon Musk's pay plan. Every number comes from Tesla's own filings or the sources below.
